title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 04 JULY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 04 July 2026. Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in these areas. Several spells of showers will occur in Anuradhapura and Mannar districts. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Rathnapura, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
